payload.text: Brain dump payload: a mix of sermon notes, kids' soccer schedule, and consulting client follow-ups.

notes: Trusted local agent (e.g., brain-dump-processor) signs an assertion that the payload is sensitive. The classifier honors the caller-asserted class verbatim when the signature verifies. Tier-1 short-circuit prevents the classifier from second-guessing a more-informed agent. The signature verification happens against infra/agent-keys.yaml (not yet created at Phase F implementation start).
